verdict.rationale: Marlin allows a brief pre-run exchange to 'sharpen the direction' before it runs fully autonomously for up to ~8 hours, which gives some upfront steering of scope/direction, and cancellation is possible mid-run. However there is no evidence of controls to adjust depth/effort levels (e.g., quick vs deep mode) or to steer scope while the run is executing beyond cancellation. missing for 10: mid-run steering/adjustment controls, explicit depth/effort tier selection, evidence of scope changes during execution beyond stop/cancel.
